PASIHAI · Ukaguzi wa mmiliki

Muonekano & UX — Stitch integration (Stages 1–5)

Picha zote hapa ni za UI halisi inayoendesha (dev server), zilizopigwa wakati huu. Hakuna code iliyobadilishwa kwa ukaguzi huu; Stage 6–10 bado hazijaanza.

  • Home row moja: Mchanganyiko · Reels · Friends · Channels · Live
  • Kichujio + Muonekano = utilities kwenye mstari ule ule
  • Bottom nav 5 · card-lite · identity pills
  • Console errors: 0

1 · Home — Mchanganyiko

Default tab. Kadi-lite (white · hairline · radius 16). Identity pill (Rafiki/Channel/Hub/Biashara/Mbunifu) + muda. Actions: Penda · Maoni · Shiriki (na hesabu) · Hifadhi.

01-mchanganyiko.png

2 · Home — Reels

Reels tab: reel cards 4:5 (thumb 96px · play · duration · watazamaji). Player kamili = Phase 2B (bado).

02-reels.png

3 · Home — Friends

Friends tab: content kutoka marafiki pekee (posts + live activity + reels). Prompt ya Create inabadilika: "Shiriki jambo na marafiki zako…".

03-friends.png

4 · Home — Channels

Channels tab: matangazo ya channels + bidhaa. Tangazo lina orodha ya mambo makuu na CTA "Soma makala kamili".

04-channels.png

4b · Channels — discovery + mwisho

Mwisho wa tab: "Channels zinazopendekezwa" + Fuata, kisha hali halisi ya mwisho wa mkondo ("Umesoma yote kwa leo!").

04b-channels-discovery.png

5 · Home — Live (Inaendelea)

Live tab: pills 3 za hali (Inaendelea · Zilizopangwa · Zilizopita) ndani ya tab. Kadi: badge LIVE · mode (Sauti/Video) · jukwaa la wasemaji · CTA Jiunge.

05-live-inaendelea.png

5b · Live — Zilizopangwa

Hali IMEPANGWA: host · watakaoshiriki · muda, CTA "Kumbuka". Live Activity haijachanganywa na post ya kawaida.

05b-live-zilizopangwa.png

5c · Live — Zilizopita & Marudio

Hali MARUDIO: watazamaji + "Tazama tena". Mpangilio: live → upcoming → replay (deterministic).

05c-live-zilizopita.png

6 · View Mode control

Kitufe cha muonekano (jicho) kwenye safu ya Home tabs — mstari mmoja pekee. Panel: Automatic (default) · Vertical · Horizontal. "Full screen" = Stage 6 (haijaanza).

06-view-mode.png

7 · Mobile Home

Juu ya Home (390×844): header · Status/Stories (ring live/gold/video) · Home tabs 5 + utilities 2 · Create area · mstari wa hali ("Unatazama …") · mkondo.

07-mobile-home-top.png

8 · Desktop Home (juu)

1280×900: safu ya kati (col 640px), bottom nav inabaki 5, hakuna layout duplicate.

08a-desktop-home-top.png

8b · Desktop Home (mkondo)

Desktop mkondo: kadi zile zile (hakuna duplicate components), nafasi ya pembeni haitumiki vibaya.

08b-desktop-feed.png

Faili za picha (PNG 2×) zipo kwenye docs/review/stage-5/ — unaweza kuzifungua moja moja.
